loeschen.warnungTitel: Irreversible action: deletion cannot be undone.
loeschen.warnungText: Submitting this request permanently deletes all calculations, the scores of the 6 modules and your history.
loeschen.grundLabel: Reason for the deletion request (optional, for our statistics)

gruende.nichtMehr: I no longer need the care file
gruende.unsicher: I have general data protection concerns

loeschen.emailLabel: Email address for the deletion confirmation
loeschen.bestaetigung: I expressly confirm that this action is irreversible and that the right to erasure (Art. 17) is hereby exercised with final effect.
loeschen.erfolgText: Your records are being removed in the background
loeschen.frist: Deletion and replication can take up to 30 days.

auskunft.titel: Data access request under Art. 15 GDPR
auskunft.untertitel: Request the complete records held for your file, both locally and on the server
auskunft.emailLabel: Email address for the encrypted data file
auskunft.versicherung: I confirm that I am the holder of this case code, or that I have valid authorisation from the data subject.
auskunft.erfolgToast: Your access request has been recorded.
auskunft.fehlerToast: The request could not be submitted. Please contact support.
auskunft.erfolgText: The statutory response period under Art. 12 (3) GDPR has started
auskunft.frist: Response within 30 days at the latest, usually much sooner

rechte.art15: Art. 15: Full right of access to your data and to the criteria used
rechte.art17: Art. 17: Right to erasure (“right to be forgotten”)
